meera: Hey folks — pinging runtime + infra for a quick approval on PR 2234. This adds a quantization-pass flag to the compilation pipeline. Needs runtime perf sign-off and infra kernel packaging check. TL;DR: changes are opt-in, default off.
hao: Can you drop the PR link and a one-liner about the risk? :eyes:
meera: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2234
meera: One-liner: adds --enable-quant-ctor to compiler phase, introduces new kernel fallback for int4. Risk: untested path for long-context sequences; safe gate with env var and canary.
jake: Runtime: I can look today. What's the canary plan?
meera: Plan: roll to canary on dedicated GPUs limited to 10% traffic, run perf + regression evals for 24h, fallback to baseline on perf hit >5% or quality regression. Need runtime + platform to own rollout.
sam (eng-infra): I can check packaging and docker layers. Any native lib bumps? 
meera: Yes bump to libx 1.4.2 — manifests updated. Also added a small integration test
raj (eng-platform): Platform: we need the rollout policy config and alert thresholds in the PR. I'll add reviewers for canary automation.
sec-bot: Reminder: security review required for third-party lib bump libx@1.4.2. Please fill CVE checklist.
meera: Thanks — tagging specific owners: @jake (runtime), @raj (platform), @sam (eng-infra), @anika (security). Please give 'thumbsup' if you can review today.
hao: +1 I can help with perf tests later if needed.
jake: 👍 will review within 4 hours.
sam (eng-infra): will validate packaging tomorrow morning.
raj (eng-platform): adding automated canary job, will follow up with PR comments.
meera: Great — leaving this here for async tracking. I'll merge after approvals and green canary checks. :v:
